notes: Getting started guide on Home for new users: sign in, add the free Gemini key, pick a look, make the first video.
Your recording comes first on Home ("Choose video file"), with the link box second.
Update the YouTube downloader in one click (banner, Settings → About, or on a failed download): the usual fix when YouTube changes something, no reinstall needed.
Send a report (Settings → Help, or on a failed video): shows exactly what's sent (the recent log and setup check, with your user name, e-mails and keys hidden) and gives you a reference number.
Settings → About: links to the privacy notice, terms, refund policy, support e-mail and the licences.
Free plan + Premium subscription instead of the trial and license keys.
Out of free videos? The app says so before the long analysis starts, not after.
Settings → Account: plan, videos left, Go Premium, Manage subscription, Sign out.
